dialogue.origin: おまたせしました。相談員です。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Thank you for your patience. I'm the counselor. It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Nice to meet you too.

dialogue.origin: それでは早速ですが、年齢と性別を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: Alright, to begin, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: はい。45歳、女です。
dialogue.content: Yes. I'm 45 years old, and female.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。今日はどのようなご相談ですか？
dialogue.content: Thank you. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: 中学生の息子とうまくいかなくなって全然口も聞かないし、勉強もしてないようなのでこまってます。
dialogue.content: I'm having trouble with my middle school son. He won't talk to me at all, and it seems like he isn't studying, so I'm at a loss.

dialogue.origin: 中学生の息子さんが口も聞かないし、勉強もしないとのことですね。それはとても心配ですね。
dialogue.content: So, your middle school son won't talk to you and isn't studying. That must be very worrying.

dialogue.origin: イライラします。
dialogue.content: It's frustrating.

dialogue.origin: イライラするのですね。そうですか。お話できる範囲で、もう少し詳しい状況を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: It's frustrating for you. I see. As much as you are comfortable sharing, could you tell me a little more about the situation?

dialogue.origin: 受験生なのに全然勉強しないから注意すると、口応えばっかりするし、最近は全然部屋から出なくなって話もしません。それでなくても学校が休みになったりしてるのに、ゲームとかスマホばかりなんです。
dialogue.content: He's supposed to be preparing for entrance exams, but he doesn't study at all. When I tell him he should, he just talks back. Lately, he won't come out of his room or talk to me at all. On top of that, even with school being closed sometimes, he just spends all his time playing games or on his smartphone.

dialogue.origin: 勉強せず、部屋からも出ず、ゲームやスマホばかり。それはイライラしますね、親として。他はどうですか？
dialogue.content: Not studying, staying in his room, and spending most of his time on games and his phone—that’s understandably frustrating as a parent. How are things in other areas?

dialogue.origin: ゲームは少しですが課金もしてるようだし、このままだと引きこもりにならないか心配です。
dialogue.content: It also seems like he's making in-app purchases for his games, even if it's a small amount. I'm worried that if this continues, he might become a shut-in.

dialogue.origin: 課金ですか。引きこもりも心配ですね。いつごろからですか？
dialogue.content: In-app purchases, you say. And you're worried about him becoming a shut-in. When did this begin?

dialogue.origin: 今年の春過ぎくらい。去年は学校が休校であまり勉強しなくても良かったけど、今はやらないとまずいから注意してたら今の状態になりました。
dialogue.content: Around late spring this year. Last year, his school was closed, so it was okay that he didn't study much, but now he really has to, so I started telling him that, and this is the situation we're in now.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、今年の春からですね。そのような息子さんに対して、どのようの接していらっしゃるのですか？例えば、どのような言葉をかけられますか？
dialogue.content: I see, so it started this spring. How have you been interacting with your son in this situation? For example, what kinds of things do you say to him?

dialogue.origin: 最初は学校は今はどう？とか勉強難しい？とか聞いてましたが、全然返事がないので、今は、ご飯できたよ、ぐらいです。
dialogue.content: At first, I would ask things like, 'How's school going?' or 'Is studying hard?' but I never got any response. So now, it's pretty much just, 'Dinner's ready.'

dialogue.origin: 今は、ご飯できたよ、ぐらいなんですね。あまりあれこれ言わずに、かなり我慢して接していらっしゃるのですね。
dialogue.content: So now it's mostly just 'Dinner's ready.' It sounds like you're being very patient and holding back from saying too much.

dialogue.origin: はい。言ってもきかないので。
dialogue.content: Yes. Because he doesn’t listen anyway.

dialogue.origin: そうですか。素晴らしいと思います。その分ご自身の中でイライラが募るのですね。私も子育てしましたので、すごく共感できます。
dialogue.content: I see. I think that’s commendable. At the same time, the frustration builds up inside you. I’ve raised children myself, so I can really empathize.

dialogue.origin: 他のご家族と息子さんの関係はいかがですか？
dialogue.content: How is your son's relationship with other family members?

dialogue.origin: 小学生の弟がいますが、歳が離れているので前は遊んであげたりしてましたが、今は弟ともあまり話さなくなりました。だんなが怒るときは一応ハイとかいうけど、ほとんどは放っておけと言う感じで。
dialogue.content: He has a younger brother in elementary school, and since there's an age gap, he used to play with him, but now he doesn't talk much to his brother either. When my husband gets angry, our son will at least say 'yes' or something, but mostly my husband says to just leave him alone.

dialogue.origin: ご主人は、放っておけという感じなんですね。その年代の男の子は、多かれ少なかれ母親に対してそのような態度を取るとは思いますが。（自分もそうでした：笑）反抗期とも思いますが、いかがですか？
dialogue.content: So your husband's approach is to leave him be. Boys that age often have that kind of attitude toward their mothers to some extent. (I was the same way, haha.) It could be a rebellious phase, what do you think?

dialogue.origin: 頭からではわかるのですが、受験勉強して！と思います。
dialogue.content: I understand that intellectually, but I just want him to study for his exams!

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。勉強しないととても心配になりますよね。後、引きこもりになるのではとか、ゲームの課金で高額請求されるとか・・・本当に心配ですね。
dialogue.content: I understand completely. It's very worrying when they don't study. And then there are fears about him becoming a shut-in, or racking up huge bills from in-app purchases... That's a lot to worry about.

dialogue.origin: ご主人はどのようにおっしゃってますか？
dialogue.content: What does your husband say about all of this?

dialogue.origin: 課金は絶対やめさせろとは言います。でも高校進学はあまり興味がないのか、私がいくらだんなに言っても行けるところ行けばいいじゃんてなります。
dialogue.content: He says I absolutely have to make him stop the in-game purchases. But he doesn't seem very interested in which high school he goes to; no matter how much I talk to my husband about it, he just says, 'He can go wherever he can get into.'

dialogue.origin: ご主人が息子さんに怒られるということですが、課金や進学について息子さんと話されることはないのですか？
dialogue.content: You mentioned your husband gets angry with your son. Does he ever talk with him about the in-app purchases or about high school?

dialogue.origin: あまりないです。
dialogue.content: Not really.

dialogue.origin: そうですか。それは余計に負担になりますね。息子さんはどのようなお気持ちと思われますか？勉強もされていないのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. That must put even more of a burden on you. What do you think your son might be feeling? Is he not studying at all?

dialogue.origin: 気持ちはよくわかりませんが、成績は良くないので勉強してないと思います。学校の先生からも言われました。
dialogue.content: I don't really know how he feels, but his grades aren't good, so I don't think he's studying. His teachers at school have said the same.

dialogue.origin: 進路について息子さんなりに何か考えているようなことはないでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Does your son seem to have any thoughts of his own about his future path?

dialogue.origin: 昔は理科の先生になりたいって言ってたんですけど、中学校に入ってからは特に進みたい道も聞いてないですね。高校に行きたいのかどうかもあやしいです。
dialogue.content: He used to say he wanted to be a science teacher, but since entering middle school, I haven't heard about any particular path he wants to pursue. I'm not even sure if he wants to go to high school.

dialogue.origin: こうしろと言わずに、進路について心配していることや引きこもりになるのではないかと心配していることなど、あなたの素直な気持ちを一度息子さんに伝えてみたらどうでしょうか？たとえ返事がなくても。
dialogue.content: Instead of telling him what to do, how about trying to share your honest feelings with him? For example, that you're worried about his future path and afraid he might become a shut-in. Even if he doesn't respond.

dialogue.origin: そういえば、話したことはなかったですね。どうせ返事がないと思えばイライラしないかな。
dialogue.content: Now that you mention it, I haven't really talked to him like that. Maybe if I don't expect a reply, I won't get so frustrated.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。返事にとらわれない。あなたの気持ちだけを伝えてみたらと思いますがいかがでしょうか？手紙やメモでも良いかも。何かが変わるかも知れません。
dialogue.content: Yes. Try not to get caught up in whether he responds. How about just conveying your feelings? A letter or a note could also work. Something might change.

dialogue.origin: 紙に書くならできそうですね。
dialogue.content: Writing it down on paper seems doable.

dialogue.origin: また、よろしければ結果を聞かせてください。応援しています。それでは今日はここで終了させていただいてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: If you'd like, please let me know how it goes. I'm rooting for you. Would it be all right if we conclude our session for today?

dialogue.origin: はい。やってみます。ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Yes. I’ll give it a try. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。では、失礼いたします。
dialogue.content: Thank you. Goodbye for now.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

topic.sub: 中学生の息子とのコミュニケーション問題
